meta.title: NBA Facts Test Suite — Comprehensive Test Cases
meta.description: Structured NBA facts organized by category for building a test suite. Sources verified from basketball-reference.com, nba.com, and authoritative sports databases.

testCases.question: Who are the top 3 all-time NBA regular season points leaders?
testCases.notes: LeBron is active; totals accurate as of May 2026. Kareem held the record from 1984-2023.

testCases.question: Who are the top 3 all-time NBA regular season assists leaders?
testCases.notes: Stockton's record is widely considered unbreakable — 3,000+ assists ahead of #2.

testCases.question: Who are the top 3 all-time NBA regular season rebounds leaders?
testCases.notes: Offensive and defensive rebounds were not separately tracked early in NBA history. Kareem is #3 (17440), not Moses Malone.

testCases.question: Who are the top 3 all-time NBA regular season steals leaders?
testCases.notes: Steals only officially tracked since the 1973-74 season.

testCases.question: Who are the top 3 all-time NBA regular season blocks leaders?
testCases.notes: Blocks only officially tracked since the 1973-74 season. Wilt Chamberlain's blocks were never officially recorded.

testCases.question: Who are the top 3 all-time NBA regular season three-point field goal leaders?
testCases.notes: Curry surpassed Ray Allen's record on Dec 14, 2021. The 3-point line was only introduced in 1979-80.

testCases.question: What is the highest points per game average in a single NBA season?
testCases.notes: Wilt holds the top 4 spots. Michael Jordan's 37.09 in 1986-87 is 5th — the highest by a non-Wilt player.

testCases.question: What is the most total points scored in a single NBA season?
testCases.notes: Wilt averaged 50.4 PPG over 80 games. No player has scored 4,000 points in a season since.

testCases.question: What is the highest assists per game average in a single NBA season?
testCases.notes: Stockton holds the top 5 single-season APG records. No active player has come close.

testCases.question: What is the most total assists in a single NBA season?
testCases.notes: Stockton also had 1,134 in 1989-90. Both are far ahead of the rest of NBA history.

testCases.question: What is the highest rebounds per game average in a single NBA season?
testCases.notes: Wilt owns the top 6 single-season RPG marks. His 27.2 RPG is arguably the most unbreakable record in sports.

testCases.question: What is the most total rebounds in a single NBA season?
testCases.notes: Wilt also had 2,052 rebounds in 1961-62. No other player has ever reached 2,000 in a season.

testCases.question: What is the most points scored by a player in a single NBA game?
testCases.notes: Wilt's 100 is the longest-standing record. Bam Adebayo scored 83 in 2026 (confirmed via BBR). Kobe's 81 is now #3.

testCases.question: What is the most assists in a single NBA game?
testCases.notes: Record since 1983-84 season (when full play-by-play tracking began). Early NBA records are incomplete.

testCases.question: What is the most rebounds in a single NBA game?
testCases.notes: Set against Bill Russell and the Celtics. No player has grabbed 40+ rebounds since the 1970s.

testCases.question: Which NBA team has the most championships?
testCases.notes: Celtics broke the tie with the Lakers in 2024. Lakers' titles include Minneapolis Lakers era (5 titles).

testCases.question: Who won the NBA championship in 2004 and who was Finals MVP?
testCases.notes: Major upset — Lakers had Shaq, Kobe, Malone, and Payton. Pistons won with defense.

testCases.question: Who won the NBA championship in 1995 and who was Finals MVP?
testCases.notes: Rockets were a #6 seed — the lowest seed to ever win a championship. Olajuwon dominated Shaq in the Finals.

testCases.question: Who were the NBA Finals MVPs from 2020 to 2024?
testCases.notes: First career Finals MVP for each of Curry and Brown. LeBron won his 4th in 2020.

testCases.question: Who won the NBA MVP awards from 2020 to 2024?
testCases.notes: Jokic won 3 of 5 MVPs. Embiid's 2023 win was his first. Giannis won back-to-back in 2019 and 2020.

testCases.question: Who won the NBA Rookie of the Year awards from 2020 to 2024?
testCases.notes: Wembanyama was a unanimous ROY. Banchero won the award as the #1 pick in 2023.

testCases.question: Who won the NBA Defensive Player of the Year awards from 2020 to 2024?
testCases.notes: Smart is the only guard to win DPOY since Gary Payton in 1996. Gobert is a 4-time winner.

testCases.question: What happened to the Seattle SuperSonics?
testCases.notes: Seattle retains rights to the SuperSonics name, logo, and colors. The Thunder inherited the franchise's history.

testCases.question: How many NBA teams are there currently, and what conference are the Boston Celtics in?
testCases.notes: NBA has had 30 teams since the Charlotte Bobcats (now Hornets) joined in 2004.

testCases.question: Who were the #1 overall draft picks from 2020 to 2024?
testCases.notes: Wembanyama was widely considered the most hyped prospect since LeBron in 2003.

testCases.question: What were Victor Wembanyama's rookie season averages in 2023-24?
testCases.notes: Won ROY unanimously. Led the league in blocks as a rookie.

testCases.question: How many games were played in each team's regular season during the 1998-99 lockout season?
testCases.notes: Shortest season in NBA history (by games). The Spurs won the first of their 5 titles.

testCases.question: How many games were played in each team's regular season during the 2011-12 lockout season?
testCases.notes: Season started on Christmas Day. LeBron won his first championship.

testCases.question: Which NBA player has played for the most franchises?
testCases.notes: Chucky Brown (12) and Jim Jackson (12) are tied for 2nd. Smith's record includes multiple stints with some teams.

testCases.question: Are there any NBA players with the exact same name who played in the league?

expectedAnswer.details: Three different players named George Johnson played in the NBA (1970s-80s): George Johnson (C, played for Bulls), George T. Johnson (C/PF, played for Warriors/Bucks/Nuggets/Spurs), and George E. Johnson (PF, played for Rockets) — not related.

testCases.notes: There have been at least 3 George Johnsons and 3 Charles Joneses. Some were contemporaries who played in the same era.

testCases.question: Who has the shortest NBA career?

expectedAnswer.reason: Signed a 10-day contract, played 3.9 seconds in his only game, never played again

testCases.notes: Not related to Stephen Curry. He came into the game, committed a foul, and was substituted out.

testCases.question: Who holds the record for most NBA regular season games played?

expectedAnswer.note: LeBron has surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar (1,560) and Robert Parish (1,611) as of the 2025-26 season

testCases.notes: LeBron also holds the record for most career points and most career minutes. Parish's record stood from 1996.

testCases.question: Who holds the record for most rebounds in a game with 0 points scored?

expectedAnswer.note: Rodman had multiple games with 20+ rebounds and 0 points. He finished with 25 rebounds and 0 points on 1994-01-15 as well.

testCases.notes: Rodman was famous for focusing exclusively on rebounding and defense. He had 28 rebounds, 0 points, 0 assists in one game.

testCases.question: Who has the most field goal attempts in a game with 100% shooting?
testCases.notes: Wilt had multiple perfect shooting games. He also went 14-14, 12-12, etc.

testCases.question: Who has the most career triple-doubles in NBA history?
testCases.notes: Westbrook broke Robertson's record (181) in 2021. Robertson averaged a triple-double for an entire season in 1961-62.

testCases.question: Which players have averaged a triple-double for an entire NBA season?
testCases.notes: Jokic has also come close but has not officially averaged a triple-double for a full season yet (as of 2025-26).

testCases.question: How many official quadruple-doubles (points, rebounds, assists, steals or blocks all in double figures) have been recorded in NBA history?
testCases.notes: Wilt Chamberlain and Oscar Robertson each unofficially had several but blocks/steals weren't tracked then.

testCases.question: What is a '5x5' game in the NBA, and who has the most?

expectedAnswer.definition: A game with at least 5 points, 5 rebounds, 5 assists, 5 steals, and 5 blocks
expectedAnswer.note: Extremely rare — only a handful of players have ever recorded one.

testCases.notes: Olajuwon has the most 5x5 games in history. Wembanyama recorded one as a rookie.
